capabilities.title: DashPay private contact requests: store sync, shielded send, accept replying in kind, private-reply accept, private contact, pair-hold and public-unconfirmed reads, codes 68 to 76, readiness and restore failure

swift.reason: PrivateContactRequests.swift wraps the store sync, the shielded send, the accept replying in kind (the wallet replies privately to a request that came privately, and with a document otherwise; a public or adopted reply needs no shielded support or payment mnemonic read, and a build without shielded support refuses only a private reply, with code 69), the explicit private-reply accept, PrivateContactInfo and the wallet's pair-hold read (privatePairHeld, which answers as a send decides it, the shielded store's journal included), all signed with the identity signer the public calls take and counted as native manager operations; codes 68 to 76 are typed and pinned in ErrorHandlingTests. The sync, send and accepts have no automated or recorded gate: a private reply needs a protocol version 15 network with shielded funds. The private marker (core height 0) round-trips through the persisted coreHeightCreatedAt, but no test covers a restart; a paid reply's hold survives one in the shielded store's payment journal, which no host test exercises. The example app has the send-privately toggle, accepts with acceptContactRequestReplyingInKind, keeps a held or unconfirmed private send or reply pending by reading the wallet's per-pair hold (a failed read keeps the last snapshot and the controls off), re-enables a pair only when that read says free (a payment that never lands frees it only once the wallet proves it expired), offers a private sync for a pending request a public send or accept meets (code 71), and reports private refresh failures (quiet before protocol version 15), with no recorded gate. Code 72 (unrestored private payments) is typed apart from 71, and the readiness getter and the restore-failure reason are bound; the example app configures the shielded store when it activates a manager, before loading wallets; on each DashPay refresh while the store did not open or the readiness reads not restored it asks the wallet to retry (a repeat configure) and reads the readiness after that, refreshing again on a timer for as long as the view is shown while it stays unrestored; it shows "setting up", why the last restoration failed or why the store did not open, from 72 or the readiness, lifted only by a readiness read that says restored, never by a private sync. Code 73 (a store that cannot keep a private payment's recovery state) is typed and shown as a storage configuration error; the host declares atomic changesets with the scan state, so it should not occur. Code 74 (a private store read that did not finish) is a retry with no pending row, and code 75 (an SDK pinned below the protocol version) a developer-facing message. Code 20 (an SDK outcome left unconfirmed after a possible acceptance, which the spend contract now keeps) reads as may have gone through, as 18 does, with no retry offered. A public send or accept that returned 20 is held by the wallet until a DashPay sync settles it, and every later one to the pair is refused with code 76 (typed as publicContactRequestUnconfirmed): the example app reads that hold per pair (publicContactRequestUnconfirmed) beside the private one, shows the pair as being checked with no request or accept offered until the read says settled, shows 20 and 76 the same way at once, and runs the DashPay sync on the request list's refresh and Add Contact's Check again, reading again when any sync pass ends; no gate records it against a network.
